918241c0: ;Read user input into X, if times out set DTOUT and X to up-arrow, beep
c40b1ee7: Quit the routine if no parameters are specified.
25da0891: Initialize the data queue (DQ) array and set the next index to use.
e3320f07: Branch to the routine execution point specified by the current index in DQ.
0be77f35: If DE(DQ) exists, go to the PR label, otherwise execute W and TR.
b01b57e6: If X is empty, go to label A if DV doesn't contain 'R', go to X if DV is empty, go to X if D is negative, otherwise go to A.
bed284df: If X starts with '?', go to QS label. If X contains '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17.
df1d7abc: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2.
550892b1: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV doesn't contain 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to the value at ^(DLB). If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X.

6b51868a: If DV doesn't exist, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it. Set % to the substring after the first ';'_X_':' in ';'_DU. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write '  '_%. Go to V.
e092fc5c: Quit if there is no more fields in the input value.
457f7266: Write any remaining part of the input value and set X to the next field.
90d08522: If the Data Validation (DV) string contains a 'P', this block handles the lookup into the specified file. If the lookup is unsuccessful (X<0), it goes to the end of the routine (X).

ca6be2a6: If the Data Validation (DV) string does not contain 'N' (numeric validation), go to the V label. Otherwise, perform numeric validation and cleanup. If the numeric value is longer than 24 decimal places, kill X and go to Z.

e059ea1e: If the DV string specifies a maximum numeric length and the input contains a decimal point (but is not a dollar amount), remove any leading zeros before the decimal and any trailing zeros after the decimal. If the decimal portion becomes null, treat the input as an integer.
2e98af5f: Remove the variable Y and all entries in the YS array.

d842cc5e: Clear the DIC("S") and DLAYGO variables. If the X variable is defined and not null, store its value in DG(DW). If DV contains the letter 'd', store the value of X in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) and go to the label A.
8da91e27: If the DB(DQ) array is defined, write a beep and a '??' to the screen, and go to the Z^DIE17 label.
6cb7baf4: Set the X variable to the string '?BAD'.
5c422397: Set the DZ variable to the value of X. Call the D label, then call the QQ^DIEQ routine, and go to the B label.

8f2d7b73: Set the D variable to the value of DIFLD. Store the concatenated values of DLB, DV, DU, DW, and the second piece of the $T(@("X"_DQ)) special variable in the DQ(DQ) array. Return without further processing.

dc322768: If the DE(DQ) array is not defined, execute the O label. If 'X' does not contain '@', go to the RD label. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@', go to the A label. If X is '@', set X to Y and go to the N label.
2d5f5c34: Set DG to DV, Y to DE(DQ), and X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute the code stored in it, then go to the RP label.

ea9782f0: If DG contains 'P' and the global node ^(0) for the global root X exists, set X to the second piece of that node. If the global node for the Y subscript does not exist under that global root, go to the RP label. Otherwise, set Y to the first piece of that node, X to the third piece of the 0th node of the DD(X,.01) global, and DG to the second piece of that node. Then go to the R label.

b0e78c76: If DG contains 'V', Y is numeric, the second piece of Y (delimited by ';') contains '(', and the global node specified by that second piece exists, set X to the second piece of the 0th node of that global. If the node for the numeric subscript Y under that global root does not exist, go to the RP label. Otherwise, set Y to the first piece of that node. If the 0th node of the DD(+X,.01) global exists, set DG to the second piece and X to the third piece of that node, then go to the R label.

451ff92a: If DG contains 'D', execute the ^DD("DD") routine. If DG contains 'S', set the % variable to the second piece of the X variable, delimited by ';' and Y_':'. If % is not null, set Y to its value.
